inventory.model: Matrix producers are one roster entry with an explicit expansion. The 41 CI jobs expand to 45 visible contexts; changelog discipline makes the unconditional floor 46. Admin, surface parity, and Dependabot add the nine conditional contexts observed on PR #3086.

cost_classes.tiny: Usually at most 30 seconds of runner time or an expected skip.
cost_classes.small: Usually more than 30 seconds and at most 90 seconds.
cost_classes.medium: Usually more than 90 seconds and at most 3 minutes.
cost_classes.large: Usually more than 3 minutes or on the observed critical path.
